props.text:
The editor is a client of the same API as every other screen:

  GET  /api/playbooks/palette              what can be dragged, and why not
  GET  /api/playbooks/{id}/versions        the draft to open
  POST /api/playbooks/{id}/versions        save the draft
  POST /api/playbooks/versions/{id}/validate
  POST /api/playbooks/versions/{id}/simulate
  POST /api/playbooks/versions/{id}/publish

There is no editor-only endpoint and no editor-only format: the canvas
serialises to the definition the engine executes.
